name: leetcode-revision-tracker
description: Full-stack MERN app to track and revise LeetCode problems

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../landing && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:landing" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && set BROWSER=none && npm start
scripts.build:all: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../landing && npm run build
